description: Erection of a second floor rear extension and change of use of the first floor from Class E (retail) to Class C3 (residential) to provide 6 self contained residential units, alterations to the ground and first floor rear fenestration including the removal of rear external stairs, provision of refuse and cycle stores and new pedestrian access boundary gates to rear.
decision_conditions: The proposal is considered to be unacceptable on the grounds of housing quality. More particularly the internal arrangements  of the proposed dwelling would provide inadequate provision of natural lighting and outlook for the occupiers of  "Unit 1" and "Unit 2"on the first floor and "Unit 5" and "Unit 6" on the second floor. The proposal would therefore fail to provide a high standard of living accommodation for the future occupiers of this dwelling contrary to Policy D6 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy 9 of Sutton's Local Plan 2018, and Sutton's Urban Design Guide Supplementary Planning Document (SPD) 14 "Creating Locally Distinctive Places".
